§6Lepton Cannon§f

§aFires charged leptons. Electrons, muons, or tau particles at your enemies.§f

The Lepton Cannon is one of three QMD endgame weapons. Right-click to fire a lepton projectile that deals heavy burst damage and applies radiation poisoning.

Craft from an Elite Processor, Elite Plating, Super Alloy, Extreme Alloy, and BSCCO Wire. It needs a fuel cell, likely a Positron Cell or Muonium Cell. Check the tooltip.

Same radiation poisoning mechanic as the Gluon Gun. Hit them once for burst damage, then watch them melt from radiation.

§cWARNING:§f Do not fire near antimatter cells. The lepton burst can trigger detonation. Same rule as the Gluon Gun.

§ePS:§f All three endgame weapons use Elite Processors. Stock up before you start crafting your arsenal.
